 Are banks, post offices closed on Thanksgiving 2026?
 Bailey Allen, USA TODAY NETWORK - New England 2026년 11월 17일 화 오전 10:10 UTC 0 Thanksgiving, a holiday known for large turkey dinners and joyous gatherings with loved ones, is just around the corner.
 This year, Thanksgiving falls on Thursday, Nov. 26. The holiday has been celebrated on the fourth Thursday of November every year since 1942.
 Thanksgiving Day is one of 11 federal holidays in the U.S., meaning it is a paid day off for federal employees, with closures observed at government offices, financial institutions, schools, and certain businesses.
 This means you likely won't receive that package you were hoping for on Nov. 26, and your trash may not be picked up that Thursday. You should also plan to visit the bank before Thanksgiving, as most branches will be closed for the holiday.
 More: How is the date of Thanksgiving decided? When it became a holiday 
 Here's what to know about 2026 Thanksgiving closures.
 Who gets the day off work and school on Thanksgiving Day?
 Thanksgiving Day is listed as one of 11 federal U.S. holidays, according to the  U.S. Office of Personnel Management .
 Most federal workers and private sector workers are entitled to paid holiday time off.
 Schools are closed on Thanksgiving Day, but with some exceptions.
 Is the stock market closed on Thanksgiving 2026? When is it usually open?
 The New York Stock Exchange, Nasdaq, and bond markets will all be closed on Thursday, Nov. 26. Those markets are typically open Monday through Friday, aside from select holidays.
 Will banks be open or closed on Thanksgiving Day 2026?
 Most banks and their branches will be closed on Thanksgiving Day, including Bank of America , TD Bank , Chase Bank , and Capital One .
 Bank ATMs and digital banking features will still be in service.
 Advertisement
 Will you get mail on Thanksgiving 2026? Does USPS deliver?
 Mail is not delivered on federal holidays, so you will not receive your regular mail or packages on Thanksgiving Day. Post offices will be closed Thursday, Nov. 26.
 Only Priority Mail Express will be delivered that day.
 Will FedEx and UPS have deliveries and pickups on Thanksgiving 2026?
 FedEx  and  UPS will suspend their regular delivery and pickup services on Thanksgiving Day.
 The only deliveries made by FedEx on Nov. 26 will be through FedEx Custom Critical , while UPS will only deliver mail that day via UPS Express Critical .
 Will there be trash pickup on Thanksgiving 2026? Check garbage collection schedules in your community
 There's a good chance you won't have trash pickup because of the holiday.
 Trash pickup is typically delayed for a day if the scheduled pickup falls on Thanksgiving.
 Check your local provider to see how your garbage pickup might be affected.
 Are libraries and RMV offices open on Thanksgiving Day 2026?
 Public libraries will be closed on Thanksgiving Day, Nov. 26. So will the Registry of Motor Vehicles (RMV).
 When is the next federal holiday? Christmas and New Year's Day are next
 The next federal holiday is Christmas, which falls on Friday, Dec. 25. A week after Christmas, the first federal holiday of 2027 will fall on Friday, Jan. 1.
 Later in January, Martin Luther King Jr. Day falls on Monday, Jan. 18. 
 Catherine Messier of the USA Today Network contributed to this report. 
 This article originally appeared on Telegram & Gazette: Are banks, post offices closed on Thanksgiving 2026?
